**Before you post:** check [`docs/04-roadmap.md`](../../docs/04-roadmap.md) —
your idea may already be scoped for v1.1, v2, or v3. If so, this issue still
helps by showing there's demand for it; just say so instead of duplicating it.

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem from the shop owner's point of view — what's slow,
missing, or annoying today.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Doesn't need to be a full spec — a rough
description is fine.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing — a related requirement ID from
`docs/01-requirements.md`, a screen it would touch in `docs/03-screens.md`, etc.
